notes.testing: COHORT-MERGE A/B: does the 75-of-133 result depend on cohorts never merging? cohort_merge 10000 against 10000 (the 75 run, never merges), 500 (5 pump beats) and 100 (1 beat, the near-off control), everything else at the 75 settings: 800+400, pump_every 100, gene_subsets on, 50000-gen cap so TIME binds, 360 s, 6 objectives. One knob drives both islands (champion_cohort_merge None -> config.cohort_merge; champion_open_fight false at HEAD). 3 arms x 3 dev seeds x 2 Strogatz datasets, arms run concurrently for equal contention.
notes.outcome: 13623 generations in 360.0 s (37.8 gen/s), stopped by time. 1-R2 train 2.230e-07, val 1.194e-08. COHORTS: labels alive mean 14.91 max 23; BANDS alive mean 14.91 max 23; max distinct labels CO-RESIDENT in the elder band 1 -- NO co-mingling: one lone cohort aged past the line and merged with nobody. Max cohort age seen 13623 against merge 10000. ACROSS THE ARMS: the outcome was identical -- barmag2 early-stopped at the same generation and the same wall seconds with a byte-identical model in all three arms, and bacres1 s7014 gave the same 1-R2 and found_generation 87 in all three. Three of the four answers were fixed before the variable could act (gens 13, 43, 87, below cm100's first two-label elder band); the fourth, barmag2 s7014 at gen 205, was found AFTER cm100 had 2 labels co-resident in the elder band from gen 200 and is still byte-identical to the never-merging arm. A NULL RESULT: merging is irrelevant at these budgets. Note the `cohort_merge` EVENT is a once-per-run declaration at generation 0 (engine.rs:5218), not a firing.
